text:
Nothing in these results is a single device that charges a laptop, a phone, and a watch together. The closest is the Baseus Nomos, and it has no watch pad. Here are two ways to cover all three.

## Option 1: One unit (laptop + phone, watch by cable)
**Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 Desktop Charger, $149.99**
- It has one 140W USB-C port (enough for a 16" MacBook Pro), a retractable 100W cable, another USB-C port, a USB-A port, and a 15W Qi2 pad for iPhone 13-16.
- Only the 140W port reaches 140W. The retractable cable and the second USB-C top out at 100W, and USB-A at 15W.
- It has no Apple Watch puck, so you'd plug a watch charger into a spare port.
- It was sold out on Baseus's US store when checked on 2026-10-21, so confirm stock first.
- [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2) (affiliate link). Details: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

## Option 2: Two pieces (my pick if you use Apple devices)
1. **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall 3-in-1. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods spot on the base. The price is about $98 list, with $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. A 36W power supply is included. The phone pad tilts, and you can use it in landscape. [WIRED review with buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
2. **Anker 341 USB-C Hub (7-in-1)**, around $40, passes through up to 100W to charge your laptop while adding HDMI, an SD card slot, and extra ports. It's a good fit if your laptop draws 100W or less. [Details and Amazon link](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)

If you want to spend less on the wireless piece, WIRED's budget pick is the **ESR Qi2 3-in-1** at about $40 (down from $80), with a 33W adapter included (same WIRED link above).

## Check before buying
- **Laptop wattage:** match the charger or hub to your laptop. A MacBook Air needs about 30-35W, a 14" MacBook Pro about 70W, and a 16" about 140W ([Office Journal wattage guide](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)).
- **Apple only:** the Belkin stand's watch and AirPods pads are built for Apple devices. For Android, look for a Qi2-certified phone and a separate watch charger.
- **Prices vary:** the sources disagree on some street prices, so check the current price at checkout.

Tell me your laptop model and phone, and I can narrow this to one pick.
